class.name: FlowEmitEventNode
class.brief_description: Emits a named event with arguments to the game.
class.description: The emit event node tells the game that something happened, for example [code]give_item[/code] with the arguments [code]sword[/code] and [code]1[/code]. It has the flow input [code]in[/code] and the flow output [code]out[/code]. The event is delivered through the playback (its [code]event_emitted[/code] signal); the graph itself has no knowledge of the game. An empty [member event_name] is a configuration warning. At runtime the node emits [signal FlowGraphPlayback.event_emitted] with [member event_name] and [member arguments] when it is entered, then continues at [code]out[/code] without waiting. [FlowGraphPlayer] forwards the signal. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var event := FlowEmitEventNode.new() event.event_name = &"give_item" event.arguments = ["sword", 1] graph.add_node(event) [/gdscript] [csharp] var eventNode = new FlowEmitEventNode { EventName = "give_item", Arguments = ["sword", 1] }; graph.AddNode(eventNode); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: The arguments that are delivered together with the event. They are stored as written; there is no per-argument port.
